answer: A farm that owns the submitting key cannot also own the verifiers, since each one must be independent on the delta graph and each exposes its bond to the grove slash if it rubber-stamps. A verdict only settles when 2 independent verifiers reach the same tier, and the payout is withheld until they do. Since disagreement costs everyone the epoch, the dune audit records every split and the operator cannot buy agreement cheaply. That is 26 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
